The ISO7240x, ISO7241x, and ISO7242x devices are quad-channel digital isolators with multiple channel configurations and output-enable functions. These devices have logic-input and logic-output buffers separated by Texas Instrument’s silicon-dioxide (SiO2) isolation barrier. Used in conjunction with isolated power supplies, these devices help block high voltage, isolate grounds, and prevent noise currents from entering the local ground and interfering with or damaging sensitive circuitry.

The ISO7240x family of devices has all four channels in the same direction. The ISO7241xfamily of devices has three channels in the same direction and one channel in the opposition direction. The ISO7242x family of devices has two channels in each direction.

The devices with the C suffix (C option) have TTL input thresholds and a noise-filter at the input that prevents transient pulses from being passed to the output of the device. The devices with the M suffix (M option) have CMOS VCC/2 input thresholds and do not have the input noise filter or the additional propagation delay.

The ISO7240CF device has an input disable function on pin 7, and a selectable high or low failsafe-output function with the CTRL pin (pin 10). The failsafe output is a logic high when a logic high is placed on the CTRL pin or it is left unconnected. If a logic low signal is applied to the CTRL pin, the failsafe output becomes a logic-low output state. The input disable function of the ISO7240CF device prevents data from being passed across the isolation barrier to the output. When the inputs are disabled or VCC1 is powered down, the outputs are set by the CTRL pin.
These devices can be powered from 3.3-V or 5-V supplies on either side, in any combination. The signal input pins are 5-V tolerant regardless of the voltage supply level that is used.
These devices are characterized for operation over the ambient temperature range of –40°Cto +125°C.

blocks.text: The T78L-DC24V-C is a compact electromagnetic power relay built for use in control- and switching-circuits that rely on a 24-volt DC coil. Its small 5-pin package and PCB-mountable form make it convenient for integration into control boards or compact enclosures, where space is limited yet reliable switching is needed.

Internally it uses a single-pole double-throw (SPDT) contact configuration, letting it switch between a normally-open (NO) and normally-closed (NC) circuit depending on whether the coil is energized. When the coil receives 24 VDC, it actuates the internal mechanism, moving the common contact from NC to NO enabling circuit control with a simple coil activation.

Because of its design modest size, standard pin layout, and common relay architecture this relay is ideal for general-purpose switching tasks. It offers a balance between size and switching capacity, making it suitable not only for hobbyist or small-scale projects, but also for many industrial or automation applications where a compact, PCB-mount relay with reliable coil-driven control is required.

A modern solderless breadboard consists of a perforated block of plastic with numerous tin plated phosphor bronze or nickel silver alloy spring clips under the perforations. The clips are often called tie points or contact points. The number of tie points is often given in the specification of the breadboard.

The spacing between the clips (lead pitch) is typically 0.1″ (2.54 mm). Integrated circuits (ICs) in dual in-line packages (DIPs) can be inserted to straddle the centerline of the block. Interconnecting wires and the leads of discrete components (such as capacitors, resistors, and inductors) can be inserted into the remaining free holes to complete the circuit. Where ICs are not used, discrete components and connecting wires may use any of the holes. Typically the spring clips are rated for 1 ampere at 5 volts and 0.333 amperes at 15 volts (5 watts).

makers-283880.summary: The 24C04 is a 4Kbit serial EEPROM in a DIP-8 package. It uses a simple I²C interface, operates from 1.8V to 5.5V, and features hardware write protection.

blocks.text: The 24C04 is a serial Electrically Erasable Programmable Read-Only Memory (EEPROM) integrated circuit that provides 4096 bits of non-volatile data storage. This memory is organized internally as 512 individual registers, each holding 8 bits (1 byte) of data. Housed in a compact and industry-standard 8-pin PDIP (Plastic Dual In-line Package), the device is designed to retain stored information even when system power is removed, making it ideal for storing critical but small amounts of data.

Access to the memory array is accomplished via a simple Two-Wire Serial Interface, commonly known as I²C. This interface uses a Serial Data Line (SDA) for bidirectional data transfer and a Serial Clock line (SCL) for synchronization, allowing communication with a microcontroller using only two I/O pins. The device includes a Write Protect (WP) pin, which provides hardware-based data security. When this pin is driven to a high logic level, the entire memory array is protected from accidental overwrite or erasure, safeguarding the stored data.

The 24C04 is optimized for efficient and reliable operation in various environments. It supports both byte-wise and page-wise (16-byte) read and write operations, allowing for flexible data management. The device incorporates noise suppression filters on its inputs, ensuring stable communication in electrically noisy conditions. It operates over a wide voltage range and features a low-power standby mode, making it suitable for power-sensitive and battery-operated applications where longevity and reliability are essential.

blocks.text: The 24C04 is a two-wire, 8-pin serial EEPROM IC. EEPROM stands for Electrically Erasable Programmable Read-Only Memory. 24C04 IC has an operating voltage range from 1.7V to 3.6V, which makes it ideal to be used for 3.3V systems. This IC comes with a memory space of 4K bit and can be cascaded with 8 similar IC if expansion is required. The IC works with Serial, 2-Wire, I2C protocol (IIC/I2C), and hence it is easy to interface with most of the MCU’s and consumes less number of pins.
So if you are looking to use an EEPROM IC where low-power and low-voltage operation are essential, then this IC might be the right choice for you.
Interfacing 24C04 with a microcontroller is very easy as you only require to connect 5 pins. The interfacing diagram for 24C04 IC is shown below.

The Serial Clock SCK (pin 6) is connected to the Serial clock pin of the microcontroller, and the Serial Data SDA (pin 5) is connected to the Serial Data pin of the microcontroller. Also, like all I2C communication, SCK and SDA pins are pulled high using two pull-up resistors or while 4.7k. This will keep the bus at high state during the idle conditions.

Chip select pins (A0, A1, and A2) are useful only if more than one I2C device or EEPROM is connected to the same microcontroller, else three pins can be grounded directly. In the above diagram, we have connected the three pins to the GPIO pins so that we can cascade more than one EEPROM IC if required.

The Write Protect WP (pin 7) is provided for improving data security in the IC. The data can be written or erased on the EEPROM only if the WP pin is held low (logic 0). Else the data written on the EEPROM will remain as such. Normally this pin will be grounded (logic 0) when the protection is not needed. Data can be read from the EEPROM at all conditions irrespective of the status of the WP pin.
Used where Flash memory of MCU is less.

blocks.text: 74138 IC High Speed 1 Line of 8 Line Decoder/ Demultiplexer DIP-16

The 74138 (SN74LS138 / LS138 family) is a low-power Schottky (LS) 1-of-8 decoder / Demultiplexer that accepts three binary-weighted inputs (A0, A1, A2) and, when enabled, activates one of eight mutually exclusive active-LOW outputs (O0–O7). Two active-LOW enables and one active-HIGH enable simplify cascading and expansion, letting multiple devices be combined to form larger decoders.

When the proper enable combination is present (E1 and E2 LOW, E3 HIGH), the device decodes the three address inputs and drives exactly one output LOW while the others remain HIGH. Inputs are fully buffered and include Schottky clamp diodes to reduce ringing and improve high-speed switching integrity in bipolar memory and data-routing systems.

The LS138 is designed for TTL logic-level systems (VCC ≈ 5 V) and is commonly used where a compact, fast address decode or demultiplexing function is required. The device is available in multiple package types (PDIP, SOIC, SOP, etc.) and temperature/qualification variants.

blocks.text: 74HC4040D Falling Edge 12-Stage Binary Counter 2V-6V 25mA 98MHz SOIC-16 SMD IC

The 74HC4040D is a high-speed, CMOS-level 12-stage binary ripple counter featuring a clock input (CP), twelve parallel outputs (Q0 to Q11), and an overriding asynchronous master reset input (MR). The internal state of the counter advances sequentially on the HIGH-to-LOW (negative edge) transition of the clock input. Activating the master reset input with a HIGH voltage level clears all counter stages and completely forces all parallel outputs LOW, operating independently of the clock’s state. Each individual counter stage is constructed as a static toggle flip-flop. Built-in clamp diodes on the inputs allow the safe utilization of current-limiting resistors, enabling the chip to cleanly interface with signal voltages that exceed the positive supply line (VCC​).

blocks.text: The 330 ohm 9-pin resistor network is a highly integrated component that consolidates multiple resistors into a single, compact Single-In-Line Package (SIP). This design is fundamental for achieving miniaturization and high component density on modern printed circuit boards. By replacing several discrete resistors with one unified part, it streamlines the assembly process, reduces the bill of materials, and enhances overall circuit reliability by minimizing the number of solder joints, which are potential points of failure.

This 9-pin component is configured with a “Single Common” circuit type, identified by the letter ‘A’. In this arrangement, one of the nine pins serves as a common bus or shared connection point. The remaining eight pins are each connected to their own individual resistor, all of which are linked to this common bus. This architecture is exceptionally efficient for applications where multiple circuit lines require a common reference point, such as a set of pull-up or pull-down resistors.

Constructed with high-reliability materials including RU02 paste, this network ensures stable and consistent electrical performance. The device is clearly marked with a code like “A331G” on its body. This marking provides immediate identification of its single-common circuit architecture, confirms the 330-ohm resistance value for each of the eight resistors, and specifies a precise manufacturing tolerance of ±2%, ensuring accuracy in the end application.

blocks.text: The LM319N is a dual high-speed voltage comparator housed in a 14-pin PDIP package, engineered for rapid threshold detection in mixed-signal systems. It accepts a wide range of supply arrangements from a single 5 V logic supply up to ±15 V power rails and is optimized to provide fast, deterministic switching behavior rather than high-precision amplification.

Each of the LM319N’s two independent channels compares differential inputs and drives an open-collector output transistor, allowing direct interfacing with TTL/CMOS logic, LEDs, or small relays when paired with an external pull-up. The device balances speed and robustness with moderate input bias currents and a common-mode input range suitable for many digital and analog detection tasks.

With typical response times around 80 ns (measured at ±15 V with a 100 mV step and small overdrive), reliable output saturation characteristics, and industry-standard PDIP packaging, the LM319N is a practical choice for level-shifting, window detectors, pulse discrimination, relay drivers, and other fast switching applications where predictable comparator action is required. Its straightforward interface and availability in PDIP form factor make it easy to prototype and replace in existing designs, and it supports moderate temperature environments up to +70°C.

With a remarkable output accuracy of up to ±0.05%, the UT701 ensures precise sourcing and simulation of temperature-related parameters, making it ideal for calibration labs, field service engineers, and maintenance technicians.

This calibrator supports multiple output functions, including DC voltage, resistance, thermocouples (TC), and resistance temperature detectors (RTDs). It can simulate and measure a variety of thermocouple types—J, K, T, E, R, S, B, N, Wre325, and Wre526—as well as thermal resistance types such as Pt10, Pt100, Cu50, and Cu100, covering a wide temperature range from –200°C to 2300°C depending on the sensor type. The device also features high-accuracy cold junction compensation to ensure reliable thermocouple measurements.

The UT701 offers both manual and automatic stepping and ramping modes, including fast/slow ramp and fixed step output (e.g., 25% step-ramp), enhancing simulation capabilities in testing applications. These ramp and step functions are especially useful in validating the response of temperature control systems.

It features a 6-digit display with clear visibility and a compact design, measuring only 96 × 193 × 47 mm and weighing 410 g, making it highly portable. The instrument runs on a 9V battery (6F22) and comes with test leads, a protective cloth bag, and an English manual, packaged neatly in a gift box.

With CE and UKCA certifications, the UT701 meets international standards of safety and performance. Its intuitive interface, robust feature set, and reliable measurement accuracy make it an excellent choice for professionals involved in temperature system verification, calibration of transmitters, sensors, and temperature controllers.
High Output Accuracy: Up to ±0.05% of setting for precise calibration.

makers-450530.summary: The UNI-T UT311A is a compact, handheld vibration tester for fast, accurate monitoring of machinery health with acceleration, velocity, and displacement modes.

blocks.text: The UNI-T UT311A is a compact, palm-sized instrument designed to bring professional-grade vibration analysis into the hands of every technician and engineer. Encased in a durable, lightweight housing barely larger than a smartphone, the UT311A balances portability with robust construction, allowing it to withstand the rigors of daily industrial use. Its integrated piezoelectric sensor is tuned for high sensitivity, capturing subtle oscillations in machinery with impressive precision. The operator is greeted by a crisp 2.4-inch TFT color display that automatically rotates to stay upright regardless of orientation, ensuring measurements remain legible even in tight spaces or awkward angles.

From the moment it’s powered on, the UT311A exudes intuitive simplicity. A single-handed grip positions the thumb naturally over the primary controls, while minimal button presses transition seamlessly between acceleration, velocity, and displacement modes. Behind this ease of use lies sophisticated signal processing electronics that filter out noise and present only the most relevant data. In bright sunlight or dimly lit engine rooms, the built-in backlight and onboard flashlight guarantee that the display and measurement point are always clearly visible.

Ergonomics extend beyond the user interface. The UT311A’s battery is thoughtfully integrated to provide up to twelve hours of continuous operation on a single charge, and the inclusion of both long and short probes means technicians need carry only one device to cover a wide range of measurement scenarios. Magnetic mounting accessories can be affixed to permanent fixtures for hands-free monitoring, further reducing setup time and operator fatigue.

By merging precision sensing, streamlined controls, and rugged portability, the UNI-T UT311A transforms vibration inspection from a specialized task into a routine check that can be performed by maintenance teams of any size. Its design philosophy champions speed and simplicity without compromising accuracy, making it an indispensable tool for ensuring the smooth operation of pumps, motors, gearboxes, and other rotating machinery.

High-sensitivity piezoelectric sensing: Delivers crisp, responsive readings by converting even very slight mechanical oscillations into clean electrical signals, so subtle faults won’t slip past your inspection.
Three-mode vibration analysis: Instantly toggle between acceleration, velocity and displacement views, allowing you to target the signature most relevant to the machine fault you’re chasing.

Auto-rotatable color display: The 2.4″ TFT screen reorients itself as you turn the instrument, keeping readouts upright and legible whether you’re hanging upside-down inside a panel or working at odd angles.
Built-in LED flashlight: Integrated illumination lets you pinpoint the exact measurement point—even in shadowed or cramped environments—without juggling a separate torch.
Interchangeable probe system: Ships with both long-reach and stub probes; swap them out on the fly to access confined or recessed test points without changing instruments.
Auto power-off & data-hold: Conserves battery life by shutting down after inactivity, yet lets you freeze the current reading at the push of a button for hands-free documentation or remote viewing.
On-screen battery indicator: Continuously displays remaining charge, so you know at a glance when a recharge is needed—no more surprises mid-inspection.
Rugged, pocket-sized housing: Encased in a tough, palm-friendly shell that’s light enough to carry all day yet durable enough for harsh factory floors.
Multilingual interface: Menu and prompts are offered in eight major languages, making it easy for global teams to operate without needing a translator.
Universal USB-C charging: Recharges quickly from any modern charger or power bank—eliminating the need for proprietary adapters and keeping downtime to a minimum.

makers-447527.summary: The HW-519 TTL to RS485 Converter Module allows bidirectional communication between TTL devices and RS485 networks, ideal for industrial and automation systems.

blocks.text: HW-519 TTL to RS485 Converter Module

The HW-519 TTL to RS485 Converter Module is a versatile and efficient device used to convert TTL (Transistor-Transistor Logic) serial communication to RS485 differential signal for long-distance and noise-resistant data transmission. This module is commonly used in industrial automation, sensor networks, Modbus communication, and other systems where reliable, robust communication over extended distances is crucial.

The HW-519 module offers automatic direction control, which eliminates the need for manual toggling of RE/DE pins found in traditional RS485 modules like the MAX485. This simplifies the setup and operation of the converter, making it easier to implement in projects without the need for additional control signals or hardware.

Designed to support both 3.3V and 5V logic levels, the HW-519 module is highly compatible with a wide range of microcontrollers, including Arduino, ESP32, Raspberry Pi, and more. It is equipped with indicators like TXD and RXD LEDs that show the status of data transmission and reception, providing valuable feedback for debugging and operation.

One of the standout features of the HW-519 is its built-in 120Ω termination resistor. This resistor can be enabled through the R0 jumper to terminate the RS485 bus, ensuring stable communication over long distances (up to 1200 meters) and preventing signal reflection, which can degrade data quality. Additionally, the module includes protection components such as polyfuses and TVS diodes to safeguard the system from voltage spikes and electrical interference, which is important for ensuring the durability and reliability of the system in industrial environments.

With its compact size, ease of use, and robust performance, the HW-519 TTL to RS485 Converter Module is a great choice for projects requiring reliable, high-speed communication over long distances with minimal interference.

Effortless Communication Integration: The HW-519 simplifies the connection between TTL (low-voltage logic) and RS485 communication standards, making it easy to integrate devices with different signal types into a single communication network.

Automatic Direction Control: The module automatically manages data direction (send/receive) without requiring manual control. This feature greatly simplifies system setup, as users don’t need to manually toggle control pins during communication.

Enhanced Data Integrity: Thanks to the built-in 120Ω termination resistor, the HW-519 ensures stable, noise-resistant data transmission over long distances, preventing issues like signal reflections that could degrade data quality.

Versatile Use Across Devices: Supporting both 3.3V and 5V logic levels, the HW-519 is adaptable to a wide variety of microcontrollers and embedded systems, making it a highly flexible solution for different projects.

Real-Time Feedback: Equipped with RXD and TXD LED indicators, the module provides visual feedback about data reception and transmission. This feature helps users quickly verify that data is being transmitted correctly, which is particularly useful for troubleshooting.

Built-in Protection: The module comes with integrated protection mechanisms, like TVS diodes and polyfuses, which shield the system from electrical surges, ensuring greater durability and reliability in harsh operating conditions.

Supports Long-Distance Communication: RS485 communication allows the module to transmit data over distances up to 1200 meters. This makes it perfect for industrial, automation, and sensor network applications where distance and signal integrity are important.

Compact and Simple Design: The module’s small size makes it easy to integrate into various systems without taking up much space, while its straightforward design ensures that it’s user-friendly and accessible for both beginners and experienced developers.

Full-Duplex Operation: The HW-519 supports full-duplex communication, allowing devices to transmit and receive data simultaneously. This increases the efficiency of communication and is beneficial in systems requiring continuous data flow.
Low Power Consumption: Designed for minimal power usage, the HW-519 is ideal for battery-powered or energy-efficient systems, ensuring it doesn’t drain excessive energy while performing its tasks.

makers-382066.summary: The Converter Module 220V to 5KV steps up 220V AC to high voltage DC, ideal for mosquito zappers and insect control devices.

blocks.text: The Converter Module 220V to 5KV, often referred to as a “mosquito zapper circuit,” is a compact and high-voltage power module designed to convert standard household AC mains (220V) into a powerful high-voltage DC output, typically in the range of 3,000 to 5,000 volts. Despite its small size, this module plays a critical role in applications that require a sudden burst of high voltage at low current, such as insect-killing devices and high-voltage demonstration tools.

The core purpose of this module is to step up the voltage through a process involving switching transistors and a flyback transformer. The AC input is first rectified and filtered to DC, and then rapidly switched through a coil, inducing a high-voltage spike on the secondary winding. The output voltage is high enough to ionize air and generate a visible electric arc when two terminals are placed close together. This makes it ideal for electric mosquito swatters, bug zappers, and other pest control solutions that incapacitate insects using a sudden jolt of electricity.

The module is generally lightweight and built using durable materials to resist high-voltage wear. It is typically designed for intermittent operation, as continuous use may cause overheating or damage. For DIY hobbyists and electronics enthusiasts, it serves as an exciting component in high-voltage experiments, spark gap generators, or ignition modules.

Due to its ability to generate dangerous voltage levels, safety precautions must be observed while handling or integrating the module. Proper insulation, protective casing, and supervised use are essential to prevent electrical hazards.

In summary, the 220V to 5KV converter module is a powerful, compact, and efficient high-voltage source. Its primary use in mosquito zappers highlights its effectiveness in delivering fast, lethal electrical discharges with minimal power consumption, making it a valuable tool in both consumer devices and educational projects.

blocks.text: WS2812B is an intelligent control LED light source in the control circuit and the RGB chip is integrated in a package of 5050 components. It internally includes an intelligent digital port data latch and signal reshaping amplification drive circuit. Also includes a precision internal oscillator and a voltage-programmable constant current control part, effectively ensuring the pixel point light color height is consistent.
These types of LEDs are commonly used in RGB strip lighting where each LED is separately addressable.

The LED is mounted on a breakout board and operates at 5V which makes it handy for experimenting with the parts on a breadboard setup. Headers are supplied separately in case it is desired to wire multiple modules directly together rather than use headers.

The communication used with the LEDs is a 1-wire interface specific to these devices. There are several libraries available to handle the interfacing details including the Adafruit NeoPixel library and the more advanced FastLED library, both of which are supplied with the Arduino IDE.

There are no specific addresses for the LEDs, rather the color data for each is sent down the wire sequentially with the first LED taking the first color data that comes down the wire, the second LED taking the second color data, and so on. After all LEDs are updated, a global command is given to display the new data.

The LEDs can draw up to 60mA each though the brightness is controllable through most libraries to keep the power consumption down. If driving more than a few Arduino power pins, keep an eye on the power consumption or power directly from a separate 5V power supply.

When driving a long distance, it is recommended to insert a 330-470 ohm resistor on the DI line between the microcontroller and the first LED to dampen back reflections. For breadboard-type use, that is not really necessary, but won’t hurt.

The TEC1-12708 Thermoelectric Cooler 8A Peltier Module is the simple application of the Peltier Thermoelectric Effect. The module features 127 semiconductor couples in the area of 40mmx40mm which very effectively cools and heats up to 80°C.

Thermoelectric coolers also are known as TEC or Peltier Module create a temperature differential on each side. One side gets hot and the other side gets cool. Therefore, they can be used to either warm something up or cool something down, depending on which side you use. You can also take advantage of a temperature differential to generate electricity.

This Peltier works very well as long as you remove the heat from the hot side. After turning on the device, the hot side will heat quickly, the cold side will cool quickly. If you do not remove the heat from the hot side (with a heat sink or other device), the Peltier will quickly reach stasis and do nothing. We recommend using an old computer CPU heatsink or another block of metal to pull heat from the hot side. We were able to use a computer power supply and CPU heatsink to make the cold side so uncomfortable we could not hold our finger to it.

A thermoelectric cooling (TEC) module is a semiconductor-based electronic component that functions as a small heat pump. By applying the DC power source to a TEC, heat will be transferred from one side of the module to the other. It creates a cold and hot side. They are widely used in industrial areas, for example, computer CPU, CCDs, portable refrigerators, medical instruments, and so on.

blocks.text: XGZP180-101A is a piezoresistive pressure sensor that was designed for extremely space sensitive application where the sensing element is to be integral to the OEM products. The core is a silicon piezoresistive pressure sensing die that is designed and fabricated by MEMS technology. The pressure sensing die is composed of a springy diaphragm and four resistors integrated in the diaphragm. Four piezo-resistors build up a Wheatstone bridge structure. When the springy diaphragm is pressured, Wheatstone bridge produces a linear voltage signal(mV) that is proportional to input pressure.
With standard SOP8 package, It is easy for users to install by surface mounting or welding.

The less water in the soil means poor conductivity and will result in a higher resistance.

The Enhanced ShockBurst™ features enable significant improvements of power efficiency for bi-directional and uni-directional systems, without adding complexity on the host controller side. In Enhanced ShockBurst™ it is possible to configure parameters such as the maximum number of retrans- mits and the delay from one transmission to the next retransmission. All automatic handling is done without the involvement of the MCU. it could be for wireless mouse wireless keyboard.

ShockBurst™ makes it possible to use the high data rate offered by nRF24L01 without the need of a costly, high-speed microcontroller (MCU) for data processing/clock recovery.In ShockBurst™ TX, nRF24L01 automatically generates preamble and CRC, it compatable with nRF2401A, nRF24E1, nRF2402 and nRF24E2 communication.
If you want use 6 data pipe MultiCeiver™ for 1:6 star networks, selection Enhanced ShockBurst™
nRF24L01 in a star network configuration.

An nRF24L01 configured as primary RX (PRX) will be able to receive data trough 6 different data pipes, see Figure 4. A data pipe will have a unique address but share the same frequency channel. This means that up to 6 different nRF24L01 configured as primary TX (PTX) can communicate with one nRF24L01 configured as PRX, and the nRF24L01 configured as PRX will be able to distinguish between them. Data pipe 0 has a unique 40 bit configurable address. Each of data pipe 1-5 has an 8 bit unique address and shares the 32 most significant address bits. All data pipes can perform full Enhanced ShockBurst™ functionality. nRF24L01 will use the data pipe address when acknowledging a received packet. This means that nRF24L01 will transmit ACK with the same address as it receives payload at. In the PTX device data pipe 0 is used to received the acknowledge, and therefore the receive address for data pipe 0 has to be equal to the transmit address to be able to receive the acknowledge. See Figure 5 for addressing example.
Example on how the acknowledgement addressing is done.

An nRF24L01 configured as PTX with Enhanced ShockBurst™ enabled, will use the ShockBurst™ feature to send a packet whenever the microcontroller wants to. After the packet has been transmitted, nRF24L01 will switch on its receiver and expect an acknowledgement to arrive from the terminating part. If this acknowledgement fails to arrive, nRF24L01 will retransmit the same packet until it receives an acknowledgement or the number of retries exceeds the number of allowed retries given in the SETUP_RETR_ARC register. If the number of retries exceeds the number of allowed retries, this will show in the STATUS register bit MAX_RT and gives an interrupt. Whenever an acknowledgement is received by an nRF24L01 it will consider the last transmitted packet as delivered. It will then be cleared from the TX FIFO, and the TX_DS IRQ source will be set high. With Enhanced ShockBurst™ nRF24L01 offers the following benefits:
Highly reduced current consumption due to short time on air and sharp timing when operating with acknowledgement traffic

Lower system cost. Since the nRF24L01 handles all the high-speed link layer operations, like re-transmission of lost packet and generating acknowledgement to received packets, it is no need for hardware SPI on the systemmicrocontroller to interface the nRF24L01. The interface can be done by using general purpose IO pins on a low cost microcontroller where the SPI is emulated in firmware. With the nRF24L01 this will be sufficient speed even when running a bi-directional link.
Greatly reduced risk of “on-air” collisions due to short time on air
Easier firmware development since the link layer is integrated on chip

ECGs can be extremely noisy, the AD8232 Single Lead Heart Rate Monitor acts as an op-amp to help obtain a clear signal from the PR and QT Intervals easily. The ECG module AD8232 heart ECG monitoring sensor module is an integrated signal conditioning block for ECG and other bio-potential measurement applications.

The ECG Module AD8232 Heart ECG Monitoring Sensor Module Kit for Arduino is designed to extract, amplify, and filter small bio-potential signals in the presence of noisy conditions; such as those created by motion or remote electrode placement.

The AD8232 Heart Rate Monitor breaks out nine connections from the IC that you can solder pins, wires, or other connectors too. SDN, LO+, LO-, OUTPUT, 3.3V, GND provide essential pins for operating this monitor with an Arduino or other development board.

Also provided on this board are RA (Right Arm), LA (Left Arm), and RL (Right Leg) pins to attach and use your own custom sensors. Additionally, there is an LED indicator light that will pulsate to the rhythm of a heartbeat. With a 20000mAh battery capacity, 10W total output, four built-in cable functions, USB-A output, Type-C input, LED battery indicators, and a portable textured black body, this model is suitable for daily charging, travel, work, study, outdoor movement, and emergency power backup.

The Herigo DBK HR-011 is designed as a complete portable charging companion for users who want to avoid carrying separate cables. The supplied product images show a black textured body with built-in cable slots on the back, multiple charging connectors, LED battery level indicators on the front, and a compact rectangular design. This makes it useful for travel bags, car use, office drawers, school bags, and long daily movement.

According to the supplied package specifications, this model includes four built-in charging cable functions and supports charging up to four devices simultaneously within the supported total output limit. The available built-in cable options include Type-C cable output, Lightning cable output, Micro cable output, and USB-A cable input. It also includes USB-A output and Type-C input. The total output is rated at 5V/2A, equivalent to 10W, making it suitable for normal charging of compatible smartphones, earbuds, small accessories, and USB-powered devices.

The 20000mAh capacity makes the HR-011 a useful option for longer usage compared with smaller daily power banks. It is especially helpful when access to wall charging is limited, such as during travel, commuting, long work days, outdoor activities, or emergency backup situations. The LED indicator system helps users quickly check the remaining battery level without needing a digital screen.

باور بانك هيريجو دي بي كيه اتش ار ٠١١ هو شاحن متنقل عملي بسعة كبيرة ٢٠٠٠٠ ملي أمبير، مصمم للمستخدم الذي يحتاج طاقة احتياطية لفترة طويلة مع كابلات مدمجة تقلل الحاجة لحمل أسلاك منفصلة. يدعم المنتج شحن حتى أربعة أجهزة في نفس الوقت طبقًا لبيانات العبوة، مع قدرة إجمالية ١٠ وات، ومؤشرات ضوئية لعرض مستوى البطارية، وتصميم أسود محمول مناسب للاستخدام اليومي والسفر والطوارئ.

يأتي باور بانك هيريجو دي بي كيه اتش ار ٠١١ بتصميم عملي يحتوي على أماكن مخصصة للكابلات المدمجة في ظهر الجهاز، مع جسم أسود مزخرف ومؤشرات ضوئية في الواجهة لتوضيح مستوى الشحن. هذا التصميم مناسب لمن يريد باور بانك بسعة كبيرة يمكن الاعتماد عليه في الرحلات والتنقل والعمل والدراسة، مع تقليل فوضى الكابلات داخل الشنطة.

طبقًا للصور والبيانات المرسلة، يحتوي هذا الموديل على كابل تايب سي مدمج، وكابل لايتنينج مدمج، وكابل مايكرو مدمج، وكابل يو اس بي عادي للاستخدام كمدخل، بالإضافة إلى مخرج يو اس بي عادي ومدخل تايب سي. إجمالي الخرج المعلن هو ٥ فولت ٢ أمبير، أي ١٠ وات، لذلك فهو مناسب للشحن العادي اليومي للأجهزة المتوافقة مثل الموبايلات والسماعات اللاسلكية والساعات الذكية والإكسسوارات الصغيرة.

blocks.text: RELIFE RL-601L Card Slot Mobile Phone Motherboard Repair Fixture

RELIFE RL-601L Card Slot Mobile Phone Motherboard Repair Fixture is a professional multi-purpose fixture designed for mobile phone motherboard repair, soldering, chip removal, camera maintenance, fingerprint repair, board positioning, and accurate clamping during delicate repair work. It provides a stable working platform for technicians who need to secure small and irregular phone motherboards without movement while working with hot air, soldering stations, microscopes, or precision repair tools.

The RELIFE RL-601L is built for repair benches that require stable, repeatable, and accurate motherboard holding. Unlike simple flat holders, this fixture uses a double-slot and three-axis clamping design that allows the technician to position different board shapes more precisely. The adjustable card slots and step sliders make it suitable for a wide range of mobile phone motherboards, small electronic boards, fingerprint modules, camera modules, and component-level repair tasks.

The fixture supports motherboard soldering, chip deglue, board repair, fingerprint maintenance, camera maintenance, and general clamping work. Its structure helps keep the board steady while the technician works with heat, solder, flux, tweezers, grinding tools, or inspection equipment. Stable clamping is especially important when removing shields, reworking chips, replacing connectors, cleaning pads, or handling small board sections that must not move during repair.

The double-slot and three-axis design gives the fixture better flexibility. The board can be held using multiple card positions, while the active splint and fixed shaft help lock the workpiece in place. The push rod and buffer spring system provide controlled pressure, helping to hold the motherboard firmly without sudden rebound. This makes the tool practical for daily mobile repair work where different motherboard sizes and shapes are handled frequently.

The bottom plate uses an alloy steel structure for strength and stability. This base gives the fixture a solid feel on the bench and helps resist deformation during repeated use. The surface is designed for practical repair work, while the silicone anti-slip foot pads help keep the holder stable on the table. The high temperature resistant and anti-corrosion design makes the RELIFE RL-601L suitable for professional workshops where hot air and soldering tools are used regularly.

The fixture includes precise card slots, step sliders, a push rod structure, buffer springs, an active splint, a fixed shaft, an alloy steel bottom plate, and silicone wear-resistant foot pads. These details make it easier to secure the motherboard and reduce movement during delicate work. It is a useful tool for mobile phone repair technicians, electronics service centers, motherboard repair workshops, and professional maintenance benches.

blocks.text: XH W1209 12V Digital Temperature Controller Module W/ Display and NTC Temp Sensor
This is XH W1209 12V Digital Temperature Controller Module W/ Display and NTC Temp Sensor.

W1209 Mini thermostat Temperature controller is low-cost 12V Temperature controller with 7-segment display and 3 switch keypad for setting temperature and other parameters. The module features an NTC thermistor temperature sensing and has an accuracy of 0.1 C.

The XH W1209 digital temperature controller Module W/ Display and NTC Waterproof Temperature Sensor is an incredibly low cost yet highly functional thermostat controller. With this module, you can intelligently control power to most types of electrical devices based on the temperature sensed by the included high accuracy NTC temperature sensor.
We can display the current temperature in degrees Centigrade via its 3 digits seven-segment display and the current relay state by an onboard LED.
The thermostat will display the current temperature in °C by default. When in any other mode making no input for approximately 5 seconds will cause the thermostat to return to this default display.

To set the trigger temperature press the button marked ‘SET’. The seven-segment display will flash. You can now set a trigger temperature (in °C) using the ‘+’ and ‘-‘ buttons in 0.1° increments. If we didn’t press any buttons for approximately 2 seconds the trigger temperature will be store and the display will return back to the current temperature.

To set any parameter first long press the ‘SET’ button for at least 5 seconds. The seven-segment display should now display ‘P0’. This represents parameter P0. Pressing the ‘+’ or ‘-‘ buttons will cycle through the various parameters (P0 to P6). Pressing the ‘SET’ button whilst any of these parameters are displayed will allow you to change the value for that parameter using the ‘+’ and ‘-‘ buttons. When finished setting a parameter press the set button to exit that option. If no buttons are pressed for approximately 5 seconds the thermostat will exit the parameter options and will return back to the default temperature display.
Setting the cooling or heating parameter P0

The parameter P0 has two settings, C and H. When setting to C (default) the relay will energize when the temperature is reached. Use this setting if connecting to an air-conditioning system. When set to H the relay will de-energize when the temperature is reached. Use this setting if controlling a heating device.

This sets how much change in temperature must occur before the relay will change state. For example, if set to the default 2oC and the trigger temperature has been set to 25oC, it will not de-energize until the temperature falls back below 23oC. Setting this hysteresis helps stop the thermostat from continually triggering when the temperature drifts around the trip temperature.
Setting the upper limit of the thermostat parameter P2
This parameter limits the maximum trigger temperature that can be set. It is useful as a safety to stop an excessively high trigger temperature from accidentally being set by the user.
Setting the lower limit of the thermostat parameter P3
This parameter limits the minimum trigger temperature that can be set. It is useful as a safety to stop an excessively low trigger temperature from accidentally being set by the user.
Setting temperature offset correction parameter P4

Should you find there is a difference between the displayed temperature and the actual temperature; (for instance, if the temperature probe is on a long run of cable) you can make minor corrections to the temperature reading with this parameter.
Setting the trigger delay parameter P5
To reach trigger temperature this parameter allows for delaying switching of the relay. The parameter can be set in one-minute increments up to a maximum of 10 minutes.
Setting the high-temperature alarm parameter P6

Setting a value for this parameter will cause the relay to switch off when the temperature reaches this setting. The seven-segment display will also show ‘—‘ to indicate an alarm condition. The relay will not re-energize until the temperature falls below this value. The default setting is OFF.
Note: The 12v relay module may differ in the manufacturer’s name & type from the image.

blocks.text: The 74121 Monostable Multivibrator IC DIP-14 is a digital timing and pulse-generation integrated circuit designed to produce a single output pulse in response to a trigger event. This type of device is commonly known as a one-shot pulse generator, and it is widely used in digital timing circuits, pulse shaping, switch debouncing, trigger conditioning, and control systems that require a single, controlled pulse output. The uploaded datasheet describes the 74121 family as a monostable multivibrator with Schmitt-trigger inputs and notes that the output pulse width can be programmed using external timing components.

The 74121 Monostable Multivibrator IC DIP-14 generates one pulse of a defined duration, then automatically returns to its stable state. This makes it highly useful in projects where a momentary trigger must be converted into a clean, timed pulse. The device supports timing adjustment using an external resistor and capacitor connected to the timing pins, and the datasheet also notes that an internal timing resistor option is available for short pulse generation. The published pulse-width range extends from very short nanosecond-level pulses up to long timing intervals depending on the selected components. The datasheet front page states programmable output pulse width with Rext/Cext from 40 ns to 20 seconds, and with Rint the pulse width is typically about 35 ns.

This IC is especially practical when designing circuits for switch debouncing, timed triggers, single-shot control signals, and clock or pulse conditioning stages. It can be used to create a fixed-width pulse from a noisy or irregular input signal, helping digital circuits operate more reliably. Because it uses a 14-pin DIP package, the 74121 Monostable Multivibrator IC DIP-14 is also easy to use on breadboards, training kits, prototype boards, and through-hole PCB designs. The uploaded datasheet shows the device in PDIP-14 among the available package options.

The functional structure of the 74121 Monostable Multivibrator IC DIP-14 includes trigger inputs, timing pins, complementary outputs, and supply pins. This allows it to serve in a variety of timing-related digital applications without requiring a microcontroller. For designers, students, and technicians working on pulse generation or digital timing circuits, this component offers a simple and effective solution for producing controlled one-shot pulses. The datasheet also shows the standard 14-pin pinout and package information for the 74121 family.
Timing Control: External resistor and capacitor, or internal timing resistor option
Programmable Pulse Width: From 40 ns to 20 seconds with external timing components
Internal Timing Pulse Width: Approximately 35 ns typical using internal resistor option
Common Application: Pulse generation, timing circuits, debounce circuits, trigger shaping

When the 74121 Monostable Multivibrator IC DIP-14 receives a valid trigger, it produces a single output pulse for a preset duration and then returns to its normal stable state. The pulse width is determined by the selected timing method, either by using external RC components or the internal resistor option for very short timing. This behavior makes the device suitable for one-shot pulse generation, timing control, and digital pulse conditioning. The datasheet description and front-page feature list confirm this operating principle and programmable timing capability.
آي سي 74121 مولد نبضة أحادي الاستقرار ديب 14 رجل

يُعد آي سي 74121 مولد نبضة أحادي الاستقرار ديب 14 رجل دائرة رقمية مخصصة لتوليد نبضة واحدة عند استقبال إشارة تحفيز مناسبة، ثم يعود بعدها تلقائيًا إلى حالته المستقرة. ويُعرف هذا النوع من الدوائر باسم مولد النبضة الأحادي أو الدائرة أحادية الاستقرار، ويُستخدم بشكل واسع في تطبيقات التوقيت، وتشكيل النبضات، وتنظيف إشارات المفاتيح، ومعالجة الإشارات المحفزة داخل الدوائر الرقمية. وتوضح الداتا شيت المرفوعة أن هذا المكوّن عبارة عن Monostable Multivibrator with Schmitt-Trigger Inputs مع إمكانية تحديد عرض النبضة باستخدام عناصر توقيت خارجية.

يقوم آي سي 74121 مولد نبضة أحادي الاستقرار ديب 14 رجل بإخراج نبضة واحدة بزمن محدد بمجرد وصول إشارة التفعيل، ثم يعود بعدها إلى حالته الأصلية. وهذا يجعله مفيدًا جدًا عند الحاجة إلى تحويل أي نبضة أو إشارة تشغيل إلى خرج زمني مضبوط وواضح. يمكن ضبط زمن النبضة باستخدام مقاومة ومكثف خارجيين، كما تذكر الداتا شيت أيضًا وجود خيار استخدام مقاومة داخلية للحصول على نبضة قصيرة جدًا. وتشير الصفحة الأولى في الداتا شيت إلى أن عرض النبضة يمكن برمجته من 40 نانوثانية حتى 20 ثانية باستخدام العناصر الخارجية، بينما يكون الزمن النموذجي حوالي 35 نانوثانية عند استخدام خيار المقاومة الداخلية.

هذا المكوّن مناسب جدًا لدوائر إزالة اهتزاز المفاتيح، وتوليد نبضة مفردة، وإنشاء إشارات توقيت، وتشكيل الإشارات الرقمية، ودوائر التأخير البسيطة. كما يمكن استخدامه في التطبيقات التعليمية، ولوحات التجارب، والمشروعات التي تحتاج إلى نبضة واحدة بعرض محدد دون الحاجة إلى متحكم. وبفضل عبوة ديب 14 رجل يكون آي سي 74121 مولد نبضة أحادي الاستقرار ديب 14 رجل سهل التركيب والاستخدام في لوحات التجارب والدوائر المثقبة وتصميمات الدوائر المطبوعة من نوع التركيب العادي. كما توضح الداتا شيت المرفوعة أن من ضمن العبوات المتاحة PDIP-14.

The HOPSON TC-200 Step Up & Down Transformer 100W is a compact voltage converter designed to help you safely power 110V devices from a 220V mains supply, or operate 220V devices from a 110V mains supply—as long as you connect the device to the correct output socket and stay within the rated capacity. blocks.text: Wago LT-223-5 Panel Mount Wire Connector 5 In 5 Out – Spring Clamp Cable Terminal
Wago LT-223-5 Panel Mount Wire Connector 5 In 5 Out

The Wago LT-223-5 Panel Mount Wire Connector is a practical and efficient wiring solution designed for organized cable connection inside electrical panels, control cabinets, lighting systems, and compact installation spaces. With its 5 input and 5 output configuration, this connector allows multiple wires to be connected in a clean and structured way, making it ideal for parallel wiring and neat distribution layouts.

This model uses a spring clamp connection mechanism, which makes installation much easier compared to traditional screw terminals. Wires can be inserted and secured quickly without twisting or soldering, helping reduce installation time and making maintenance or rewiring more convenient. The spring contact system also helps provide stable electrical performance and reliable wire holding during long-term use.

Its panel mount design makes it especially suitable for applications where the connector needs to remain fixed in place inside equipment, enclosures, or distribution systems. This gives the installation a more professional and organized appearance, while also helping improve wiring stability in vibrating or frequently serviced environments.

The housing is made from flame-retardant polycarbonate, providing good insulation strength and durability for electrical use. The internal contact parts are made from copper alloy with tin plating, helping support dependable conductivity and long-term connection reliability. The connector is also reusable, allowing wires to be removed and reconnected when needed.

Because it combines multiple connection points, quick spring-clamp operation, and panel-mount convenience, the LT-223-5 is suitable for electricians, installers, maintenance technicians, panel builders, and workshop users looking for a reliable and space-saving wiring solution.

يُعد موصل الأسلاك إل تي 223-5 من الحلول العملية جدًا لتوصيل وتوزيع الأسلاك داخل اللوحات الكهربائية وصناديق التحكم والأنظمة التي تحتاج إلى ترتيب جيد للتوصيلات داخل مساحة محدودة. يأتي هذا الموديل بتصميم خمسة دخل وخمسة خرج، مما يجعله مناسبًا لربط عدة أسلاك على التوازي داخل قطعة واحدة بشكل منظم ومرتب واحترافي.

يعتمد هذا الموصل على آلية تثبيت زنبركية تساعد على توصيل الأسلاك بسرعة وسهولة مقارنة بوسائل التوصيل التقليدية المعتمدة على المسامير. يمكن إدخال السلك وتثبيته مباشرة بدون لف أو لحام، وهو ما يسهّل التركيب ويوفر وقت العمل، كما يجعل أعمال الفك وإعادة التوصيل والصيانة أكثر راحة وسرعة. ويساعد نظام التثبيت الداخلي أيضًا على توفير ضغط ثابت على السلك للحصول على اتصال كهربائي مستقر وموثوق.

ومن أهم مميزات هذا المنتج أنه مصمم للتثبيت على اللوحة، لذلك فهو مناسب جدًا للوحات التحكم، وصناديق الكهرباء، وأنظمة الإضاءة، ووحدات التوزيع، والتوصيلات داخل الأجهزة والمعدات المختلفة. هذا النوع من التثبيت يساهم في تحسين شكل التوصيلات، وزيادة ثباتها، وتنظيم مسار الأسلاك داخل النظام بشكل أفضل.

جسم الموصل مصنوع من بولي كربونات مقاوم للاشتعال، وهي خامة مناسبة للاستخدام الكهربائي وتساعد على توفير مستوى جيد من الأمان والمتانة. أما الجزء الموصل الداخلي فهو مصنوع من سبيكة نحاسية مطلية بالقصدير لدعم جودة التوصيل وثبات الأداء. كما أن الموصل قابل لإعادة الاستخدام، مما يجعله مناسبًا للتطبيقات التي تحتاج إلى تعديل أو إعادة توصيل في وقت لاحق.

إذا كنت تحتاج إلى موصل أسلاك سريع وآمن ومنظم لتوصيل خمسة خطوط دخول وخمسة خطوط خروج داخل لوحة أو صندوق كهربائي، فإن إل تي 223-5 يقدم حلًا عمليًا ومريحًا يجمع بين سهولة الاستخدام وثبات التوصيل والحجم المناسب.

Prepare the module. Separate the lens on your separator or LOCA line as usual. Place the module on ESD foam or a preheater at ≈70–90 °C for gentle softening (avoid exceeding OEM temperature limits).
Apply minimal solvent (optional). Wet the target zone with a tiny amount of adhesive remover or IPA—never flood. For sensitive OLEDs, avoid aggressive chemistry.
Choose speed & direction. Start mid‑range (e.g., Gear 3/6) and forward rotation; switch to reverse when working from the opposite side or near flex tails.
Angle and pressure. Keep a low angle (≈15–25°) and feather‑light contact so the tip skims the glue line; let speed do the work.
Segment the pass. Work in 1–2 cm strokes. Wipe residue with a lint‑free swab every pass. Re‑wet only if necessary.
Finish & inspect. Under green LED + microscope/visor, confirm there’s no glue haze at the polarizer edge; do a final IPA or OEM‑approved cleaner pass.
Map the flex zones first. Kapton tabs protect FPCs and barcodes; set rotation to push debris away from them.
Preheat over pressure. If you find yourself pressing, pause and raise preheat by +10 °C rather than increasing force.
Solvent strategy. Tool removes adhesive cleanly even without potions; use only a tiny dot of approved cleaner if residue smears.
Keep tips concentric. Replace worn heads promptly to avoid chatter and halo scratches.
Battery discipline. Use 5 V USB‑C input and avoid unknown fast‑charge bricks.

Q1: Can I use it as a T flip-flop?
Yes. Tie J and K high; each clock edge toggles the output.
Q2: Does it output both Q and Q̅?
Yes, complementary outputs are available for each flip-flop.
Q3: What supply does it need?
Yes, it uses the common 14-pin DIP layout for dual JK devices.
Q5: Can I cascade two 74109 ICs for larger counters?
Yes, use Q (or Q̅) as the next stage’s clock or gating input.

This 2-channel multifunction RF receiving controller is for sending open signal and close signal to 2 relays. Typical applications for relays include fields of electronically operated gate, windows, lifting appliance, switch, lifter, industrial control, security industry etc.

The RF controller has the advantages of high confidentiality, high stability, low power, and use expediently; no need for traditional connecting wire or dial fixing code switch, all you need to do is learn to match the code of the remote controller with the receiving controller.
Output mode of 12V 2 Channel Relay Module Wireless
The output mode of this controller is usually divided into non-lock, interlock, self-locking, non-lock and self-lock coexisting. (Note that you can switch the mode directly without deenergization)

Press key A, the corresponding relay will be actuated and keeps closed. Press A again, the relay A is disconnected. Press B, the corresponding relay is actuated and keeps closed, press B again, relay B is disconnected.
Press A, the corresponding relay is actuated and it is disconnected right after you release the key A. relay B works in the same way.
Press A, the corresponding relay will be actuated and keeps closed. When you press B, relay A will be disconnected and relay B is actuated simultaneously and keeps closed.
4.Non-lock and self-lock coexisting: disconnect JP1, connect JP2.
One relay corresponding to the remote controller is in self-lock mode, another is in non-lock mode.
Learning method of 12V 2 Channel Relay Module Wireless：

1.You will enter learning state after the led indicator of the receiver blinks once. Press any key on the controller after the led indicator blinks four times, it has received the signal, and the learning is successful. Press the learned key; you can control the corresponding relay now. Learn and configure of the two relays respectively: connect JP 1, you can press a key to learn one of the relays, disconnect JP1, you can press another key to learn another relay.
After the learning, the remote can work. You can choose one key to learn and control alone.

2.If a learned remote controller gets lost, you should clear the stored information in the receiver controller. Thus, the lost one cannot controller the receiver any more. A new one must be learned according to the above method.

lancer3d-29690.summary: Arduino Mega2560 32bit card compatible is a 32-bit ARM controller board with the Arduino Mega footprint, designed as a plug-in replacement for Arduino Mega 2560 in RAMPS-based 3D printers. It offers higher processing speed, improved performance, and compatibility with existing Mega shields and accessories.

blocks.text: Arduino Mega2560 32bit card compatible is a high-performance 32-bit ARM controller board designed with the same physical footprint as the Arduino Mega 2560, allowing it to serve as a direct replacement in RAMPS-based 3D printers, CNC machines, laser engravers, and other Arduino Mega projects. Operating at up to 100 MHz, it delivers significantly faster processing and smoother motion control compared to traditional 8-bit Mega boards.

The board maintains compatibility with the Arduino Mega form factor, enabling the use of many existing RAMPS shields and Mega accessories while providing the advantages of a modern 32-bit architecture. It is an excellent upgrade for users seeking faster firmware execution, improved motion planning, and enhanced overall system performance.
Improved processing power over traditional 8-bit boards
Compatible with many Mega shields and accessories
Ideal for 3D printers, CNC machines, and robotics

This high-power DC-DC boost converter steps a lower DC voltage up to an adjustable output of up to 50V, rated 250W and 10A. It lets you run 24V, 36V or 48V loads from a 12V battery or supply, power LED arrays and test equipment, or raise a solar panel’s voltage for a higher-voltage load. The output is set with an on-board potentiometer.
Connect the source to IN+ and IN−.
Before connecting a load, measure the output with a multimeter and set the voltage with the potentiometer.
Connect the load to OUT+ and OUT−.
A boost converter can only raise the voltage. If the input is higher than the set output, the output simply follows the input.

Output power must come from the input: Iin ≈ Pout ÷ (Vin × efficiency). For example, 24V at 4A out is 96W; from a 12V source at about 90% efficiency the input current is 96 ÷ (12 × 0.9) ≈ 8.9A. Keep the current within the 10A rating. Reaching the full 250W needs a higher input voltage, because at 12V input 10A is only about 120W.
24V/36V/48V motors, pumps and LED loads from a 12V battery
Bench testing and adjustable supply projects
Solar and battery systems that need a higher voltage
Use thick wires and a fuse on the input side.
At high power, keep the heatsinks ventilated or add a fan.
Check the input voltage range marked on the board before connecting your source.

The 1803BK is a compact PWM speed controller for small DC motors. Instead of wasting power in a resistor, it switches the supply to the motor on and off very quickly (pulse width modulation) and changes the on-time with an on-board knob. The result is smooth control from slow to full speed with little heat. The same board also dims DC LED lighting and controls the speed of DC fans.
Loads: brushed DC motors, DC fans, DC LED strips and lamps
Connect the DC power supply positive and negative to the board’s power input, following the markings.
Connect the motor, fan or LED load to the output terminals.
Use a supply voltage that matches your load: a 12V motor with a 12V supply, a 6V motor with a 6V supply.
Turn the knob to set the speed or brightness.
Speed control for small DC motors and gear motors
Small pumps, conveyor models and hobby projects
Check the voltage and current ratings printed on the board or its label, and keep the motor’s running and start-up current inside them.
This controller changes speed only. To reverse the motor, add a DPDT switch or use an H-bridge motor driver.
It is for DC loads only: not for AC motors or mains voltage, and not for brushless motors that need their own ESC.
Motors draw a high current at start-up and when stalled, so leave a good margin between the motor current and the controller rating.
1 × 1803BK mini PWM DC motor speed controller.

The J18U Surge Protector is a power strip that combines 8 AC outlets with 3 USB ports and 3 PD fast-charging ports on a 2-metre cable. It powers a complete desk or workbench from one wall socket, such as a computer, monitor, soldering station, lamp and phone chargers, while helping protect connected equipment from voltage surges.
USB ports: 3 standard USB charging ports
PD ports: 3 USB Power Delivery (PD) fast-charging ports
Electronics workbench: bench power supply, soldering iron, lamp and chargers in one place
Office and home desks with a PC, monitor and router
Charging phones, tablets and other PD-compatible devices without separate adapters

Add up the power of all connected devices and stay within the maximum load printed on the strip. Heaters, kettles and clothes irons draw a lot of power and are better plugged directly into a wall socket.
A device charges at PD fast-charging speed only when both the device and its cable support USB Power Delivery.
Do not plug one power strip into another (daisy-chaining).
Safety: this product works on 220V mains. Keep it dry, do not cover it while in use, unplug it before cleaning, and stop using it if the cable, plug or housing is damaged.
1 x J18U surge protector power strip (8 AC outlets, 3 USB, 3 PD, 2 m cable)

ekostra-30640.summary: 4-Way Arcade Joystick 1. Type: Mechanical Arcade Joystick 2. Directions: 4-Way (Up / Down / Left / Right) 3. Switch Type: Microswitch-based 4. Mounting: Panel mount 5. Use: DIY arcade sticks & custom controllers

blocks.text: An arcade joystick translates the physical movement of its lever into electrical signals using a set of internal microswitches – one for each direction – so that pushing the stick toward a direction physically presses the corresponding microswitch closed. This 4-way version restricts movement to the four cardinal directions (up, down, left, right) rather than allowing diagonal travel, which suits games and controllers designed around strict 4-directional movement rather than the 8-way diagonal movement some other arcade titles expect.

Being a purely mechanical, switch-based input, it connects easily to a USB game controller encoder board (such as a “Zero Delay” style encoder) or directly to a microcontroller’s digital input pins for a custom-built controller, making it a common choice for DIY arcade cabinet projects, custom fight sticks, and MAME-based builds where a genuine arcade-feel joystick matters more than one sourced from a mass-market gamepad.
Mounting: Standard panel mount for arcade cabinets/enclosures
Compatible with USB encoder boards and microcontroller inputs
Built for DIY arcade sticks, custom controllers, and MAME cabinets
Durable mechanical design for repeated gameplay use

The M3 Copper Spacer 30mm M/F is a high-quality, durable spacer designed for mechanical and electronic applications where precise separation between components is required. Made from copper, this spacer combines strength, excellent conductivity, and resistance to corrosion, making it ideal for a variety of environments. The 30mm length ensures a sufficient gap between components, and the M/F (Male/Female) design features a male thread on one end and a female thread on the other, allowing for easy installation with corresponding screws or bolts.

Copper spacers are often used in electrical, mechanical, and industrial applications where heat dissipation or electrical grounding is needed, as copper provides excellent thermal and electrical conductivity. This spacer is commonly used in electronics, computers, solar power systems, robotics, and machinery, ensuring stability and reliability in assemblies.

It detects extrusion errors caused by filament runout, nozzle clogging, filament tying, and extruder trouble. It has two signal outputs and indicator lights to distinguish between clogging or filament runout.
